remarks: Set on a peaceful cul-de-sac in Nellie Gail Ranch, this 4,500 sq ft five-bedroom home sits on an expansive 20,000 sq ft lot with sweeping hill views and spectacular sunsets. The coveted main-floor primary suite is a true retreat, featuring a private sitting area and a spacious bath with a luxurious soaking tub. A second main-floor bedroom with its own en-suite bath offers ideal flexibility for guests or multigenerational living. Upstairs, a versatile loft and three generously sized bedrooms provide room for everyone, including one en-suite bedroom and two bedrooms connected by a Jack and Jill bath.
